publisher: Parker English 怕渴英文（TOEIC 聽力模擬試題）
label: 聽力 3

ex.en: 1. Please help yourself to some refreshments.

tips.t: Light refreshments will be served. 會提供簡單茶點（活動公告必考）。
appetizing dishes 令人垂涎的菜餚。

ex.en: 9. You've already processed the refund, right?
ex.zh: 9. 你已經處理好退款了吧？

tips.t: full refund 全額退款；non-refundable 不可退。

ex.en: 10. Who was selected as the keynote speaker for this year's interior design convention?
ex.zh: 10. 今年室內設計大會選了誰當主講人？

tips.t: keynote speaker 主講人；keynote address 主題演講。

ex.en: (B) There was a great turnout at the convention.

tips.t: a large turnout 出席踴躍。

ex.en: (A) The conference room will be occupied then.

tips.t: The room is occupied. 房間有人使用中。

ex.en: 17. Do you prefer the current edition of the flyer or the original one?
ex.zh: 17. 傳單你比較喜歡現在的版本還是原本的？

ex.en: 18. Did you get the customs declaration card?
ex.zh: 18. 你拿到海關申報單了嗎？

tips.t: go through customs 通關；customs declaration 海關申報。

ex.en: 20. Has Mr. Kingsley decided to allow the pay cuts or offer early retirement to the employees as part of the restructuring?
ex.zh: 20. Kingsley 先生決定好了嗎？重整要用減薪，還是讓員工提前退休？

ex.en: (A) Too bad that the company went bankrupt.

lq.q: Please help yourself to some refreshments.
lq.zq: 請自行取用點心飲料。
opts: Some basic requirements.
Thanks, they look very appetizing.
It wasn't quite helpful.

lq.q: What do you suggest we do with the extra income?
lq.zq: 你建議我們怎麼運用這筆額外收入？
opts: I bought some extra materials.
Don't let the guests come in yet.
I would invest in stocks.

lq.q: Did your copy machine break down again?
lq.zq: 你的影印機又壞了嗎？
opts: Yeah, we can talk about it at break.
Yes, it stopped working an hour ago.
I appreciate it.
zo: 是的，一小時前就不動了。

lq.q: This 3D printer has a warranty, doesn't it?
lq.zq: 這台 3D 印表機有保固，對吧？
opts: I was told it has a lifetime one.
He doesn't have it at all.
It is guaranteed free of preservatives.

lq.q: How do I log on to this computer?
lq.zq: 這台電腦要怎麼登入？
opts: Building B.
Let me help you.
To reduce the effects of jet lag.

lq.q: Isn't the meeting on the second floor?
lq.zq: 會議不是在二樓嗎？
opts: No, they haven't met each other.
Department heads sit in the front.
Yes, that's where it usually is.

lq.q: Didn't we visit this church last time?
lq.zq: 我們上次不是參觀過這間教堂嗎？
opts: About 25 visitors.
We haven't seen this one yet.
This bus goes to our destination.
zo: 這班公車開往我們的目的地。

lq.q: What did you think of the opera?
lq.zq: 你覺得那齣歌劇怎麼樣？
opts: I think the operator could be more efficient.
In full cooperation with the theater.
I liked the set and the costumes.
zo: 我覺得接線員可以更有效率。
我喜歡舞台布景和服裝。

lq.q: You've already processed the refund, right?
lq.zq: 你已經處理好退款了吧？
opts: Yes, I did it early this morning.
Yes, the word processing program.
We're still underfunded.
zo: 是的，今天一早就處理了。

lq.q: Who was selected as the keynote speaker for this year's interior design convention?
lq.zq: 今年室內設計大會選了誰當主講人？
opts: I guess Rebecca has the key.
There was a great turnout at the convention.
Ms. Roper, according to the newsletter.
zo: 我想鑰匙在 Rebecca 那裡。
根據電子報，是 Roper 女士。

lq.q: How do I get into the office building on the weekend?
lq.zq: 週末要怎麼進辦公大樓？
opts: The conference room will be occupied then.
Turn off the lights before you leave.
Scan your ID badge at the door.

lq.q: Where would you like to meet to review this financial report together?
lq.zq: 你想在哪裡碰面一起看這份財務報告？
opts: In the cabinet by the copier.
I'll drop by your office later.
Two blocks away from here.
zo: 我晚點去你辦公室找你。

lq.q: Do you know who will be leading the training session today?
lq.zq: 你知道今天的訓練課程由誰主持嗎？
opts: It'll be in the main conference room.
About our hiring practices.
Isaac Murphy.

lq.q: Why do you insist on taking the subway for commuting?
lq.zq: 你為什麼堅持搭地鐵通勤？
opts: I am planning to go there by cab.
Because the community center is under construction.
Since it's cheaper and faster.
zo: 因為社區中心正在施工。
因為比較便宜又比較快。

lq.q: You ordered more parts for the motor, right?
lq.zq: 你有多訂一些馬達零件，對吧？
opts: Thanks, it's a new model.
Yes, last week.
Yes, he was promoted.

lq.q: How did you get to be so good on the violin?
lq.zq: 你小提琴怎麼拉得這麼好？
opts: The play was way better than expected.
By a top-notch violinist from England.
I used to major in performing arts.
zo: 由一位來自英國的頂尖小提琴家。

lq.q: Do you prefer the current edition of the flyer or the original one?
lq.zq: 傳單你比較喜歡現在的版本還是原本的？
opts: I like the smaller one.
Please print five of them.
My flight leaves this evening.

lq.q: Did you get the customs declaration card?
lq.zq: 你拿到海關申報單了嗎？
opts: It's custom-made.
Yes, I will pay with my credit card.
Yes, but they gave me the Japanese version.
zo: 拿到了，但他們給我的是日文版。

lq.q: Why don't we finish discussing this after lunch?
lq.zq: 我們午餐後再把這個討論完如何？
opts: No, just a chicken sandwich.
They're on the third floor.
Sure, I'll come back then.
zo: 不用，一份雞肉三明治就好。

lq.q: Has Mr. Kingsley decided to allow the pay cuts or offer early retirement to the employees as part of the restructuring?
lq.zq: Kingsley 先生決定好了嗎？重整要用減薪，還是讓員工提前退休？
opts: Too bad that the company went bankrupt.
He hasn't made up his mind yet.
He didn't allow us to fire anyone.
zo: 他不准我們開除任何人。
